name: Prototype
description: Build a throwaway prototype to answer a design question. Use when the user wants to sanity-check whether a state model or logic feels right, or explore what a UI should look like.
longDescription: Two branches. **Logic** (`LOGIC.md`): a shareable HTML file with free-play buttons and guided walkthroughs that push a state model through cases hard to reason about on paper, drivable by non-developers. **UI** (`UI.md`): several radically different variations of one route, switched via a URL search param and a floating bottom bar. **Six rules** bind both: marked throwaway code beside its module, one command to run, in-memory state, no tests or abstractions, state shown after every action, and the prototype kept on a throwaway branch with its verdict on the issue.
